blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLM agents are beginning to undertake model development itself, from creating training data to executing post-training pipelines ( Kulikov et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ; Rank et al., 2026 ) .
This opens a path toward autonomous post-training, in which an agent diagnoses model weaknesses, proposes interventions, and uses training feedback to guide further improvement.
A central question is what such a system should seek to change.

这为自主的后培训开辟了道路,其中一名代理人诊断模型弱点,提出干预措施,并利用培训反馈指导进一步改进。
一个核心问题是这样一个制度应寻求改变什么。

blocks.en:
A common approach to agent post-training is supervised fine-tuning
(SFT) on successful trajectories ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Ta et al., 2026 ) .
Yet task success does not specify which behaviors post-training
should reinforce .
Unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial
verification can lead to failure, but they can also persist in
trajectories that reach the correct outcome.
Fine-tuning on such successful trajectories can reinforce these
behaviors alongside the actions that support success.
Meanwhile, desirable behaviors may remain underrepresented even among successful trajectories.
We therefore argue that autonomous post-training should actively
shape the behaviors demonstrated by the teacher, alongside
selecting trajectories for training.

blocks.en:
A skill can change how the teacher solves a task, but observing that
change alone does not tell us how useful the resulting demonstration
will be for a student. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous
post-training framework in which an LLM agent investigates both
questions. The agent tests candidate skills in teacher rollouts,
examines which behaviors they elicit, and selects demonstrations for
SFT. It then examines the student’s evaluation scores and trajectories
to decide whether to revise a skill, apply it to different tasks, or
select different demonstrations in the next round.

blocks.en:
We further find that reducing a training–evaluation prompt mismatch can make the same trajectories less effective for learning .
With the same trajectories and SFT recipe, retaining skill instructions during training yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, even though all students are evaluated without generated skills.
The training examples suggest a possible explanation: retaining skill instructions keeps behavioral rules and their conditions of application explicit in the input.
Removing them preserves the same reasoning and actions as supervision, but may require the student to infer more of these rules from the task and trajectory.
For reasoning that explicitly references a skill, retaining the instructions also preserves the correspondence between the input guidance and the supervised output.
These findings suggest that preserving skill context can help the student better internalize the behaviors shaped during teacher rollouts.

培训实例提出了一种可能的解释:保留技能指示使行为规则及其适用条件在投入中明确。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Behavioral shaping beyond task success. We propose Skill-FT, which uses natural-language skills during teacher rollouts to shape the behaviors represented in SFT demonstrations, including on tasks the teacher already solves.
Our results suggest that such interventions can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. • Autonomous post-training framework. We introduce AutoMaster, a framework in which an LLM agent designs, executes, and refines behavioral interventions.
It jointly optimizes skill guidance and data selection using rollout evidence to guide subsequent exploration. • Skill context for behavioral internalization. Controlled comparisons across three domains and two model sizes show that retaining skill instructions during SFT improves mean performance without test-time skills.
This suggests that preserving the context behind supervised reasoning and actions can support better behavioral internalization.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent systems use LLM agents to iteratively revise training code in response to evaluation feedback ( Karpathy, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Wei, 2026 ) .
For post-training, FT-Agent ( Li et al., 2026 ) refines data and training strategies through structured planning and feedback analysis, while RSI-Master ( Du et al., 2026 ) organizes research exploration through persistent experiment records and reviewer guidance.
Within this paradigm, AutoMaster centers autonomous post-training on skill-guided behavioral shaping during teacher rollouts.
blocks.zh:
最近的系统利用LLM代理对培训守则进行反复修订,以应对评价反馈(Karopathy,2026;Chen等人,2026a;Wei,2026).
对于培训后,FT-Agent(Li等人,2026年)通过结构化的规划和反馈分析来完善数据和培训策略,而RSI-Master(Du等人,2026年)则通过持续的实验记录和评审员指导来组织研究探索.
在这一范式中,AutoMaster中心在教师推出期间自主进行技能指导行为塑造培训。

blocks.en:
Prompt and skill optimization methods use execution feedback to refine natural-language guidance without updating model parameters ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) .
Related work couples the evolution of skill libraries or procedural scaffolds with model training ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) .
Skill-to-LoRA ( Zhang and Qi, 2026 ) trains skill-specific adapters on skill-guided demonstrations, while Skill-SD ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses a skill-conditioned teacher to
score tokens in the student’s own rollouts for on-policy self-distillation.
Our work examines both how skills shape teacher demonstrations and whether retaining the skill instructions during SFT improves learning when those instructions are absent at evaluation.

相关工作与技能库或程序脚手架的演进相配,并进行模范培训(Xia等人,2026年;Ding等人,2026年)。

我们的工作既审查了技能如何塑造教师的示范,也审查了在评估时没有这些技能指示时,保留SFT期间的技能指示是否有助于学习。

blocks.en:
Prior work improves reasoning and agent capabilities by learning from generated trajectories ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Zeng et al., 2024 ) , including trajectories that demonstrate error recovery ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) .
Behavior Priming ( Jin et al., 2026 ) selects trajectories exhibiting beneficial behaviors, while PROOF-Gen ( Ta et al., 2026 ) uses per-task prompt optimization to recover verified demonstrations from teacher failures.
Skill-FT complements trajectory selection and failure recovery by actively shaping behavioral patterns during teacher rollouts, including on tasks it already solves.

Behavior Priming(Jin等人,2026年)选择显示有益行为的轨迹,而PROOF-Gen(Ta等人,2026年)则使用每个任务即时优化,从教师失误中恢复经核实的演示.
Skill-FT通过在教师推出过程中积极塑造行为模式,包括它已经解决的任务,来补充轨迹选择和故障恢复.

blocks.en: AutoMaster uses an LLM agent to develop and refine Skill-FT interventions through two nested loops (Figure 2 ). Within each setting, the teacher, training task pool, and initial student checkpoint are fixed. In the inner loop, the agent decides how to guide the teacher and which demonstrations to use for training. In the outer loop, it fine-tunes the student on the selected demonstrations and uses the student’s subsequent evaluation scores and trajectories to guide the next round.
blocks.zh: AutoMaster使用LLM剂通过两个嵌套循环(图2 )来发展和完善Skill-FT干预. 在每个环境内,教师、培训任务池和初始学生检查站是固定的。 在内部循环中,代理决定如何指导老师,以及使用何种演示来进行培训. 在外圈中,它微调学生对所选的演示内容,并利用学生随后的评价分数和轨迹来指导下一轮.

blocks.en: 3.1 Skill-FT: Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 3.1 技能-FT:技能指导的罚款

blocks.en:
To shape the behavioral patterns represented in training trajectories, we guide the teacher with natural-language skills.
These skills are designed to suppress undesirable habits and elicit effective behaviors that are underrepresented in unguided rollouts.
A skill specifies how to reason or act in relevant situations and may include behavioral principles, concrete procedures, or domain-specific knowledge.
Skills can be shared across tasks or combined to address different aspects of the same task.
For a task x x , let s s denote the combined text of the selected skills.
We append s s to the base system prompt p p and generate a trajectory through interaction with the task environment: τ ∼ Rollout ⁡ ( π T , x , p ⊕ s ) , \tau\sim\operatorname{Rollout}(\pi_{T},x;p\oplus s), (1) where π T \pi_{T} denotes the teacher model and ⊕ \oplus denotes text concatenation.
This guidance conditions the teacher’s reasoning and actions during execution, enabling behavioral interventions even on tasks it already solves.

To internalize the demonstrated behaviors, we fine-tune the student on selected teacher trajectories using standard SFT.
For each trajectory, we retain the original system prompt, including any skill instructions, so the student sees the same instructions that guided the teacher.
At evaluation, the student follows the benchmark’s official protocol without the generated skills.

blocks.en: 3.2 Inner Loop: Developing Behavioral Interventions
blocks.zh: 3.2 内部循环:发展行为干预

blocks.en: The agent begins by examining the training tasks and initial trajectories from both the unguided teacher and the initial student. It looks for habits to discourage and useful behaviors that the teacher rarely demonstrates, including on tasks the teacher already solves. In later rounds, the agent also inspects student evaluation trajectories to see where the intended behaviors appear and which weaknesses persist. These observations guide the skills it designs and the training tasks to which it applies them.
blocks.zh: 代理从无导师和初学者的训练任务和初轨开始. 它寻找的习惯是抑制老师很少表现出的有益行为,包括老师已经解决的任务. 在随后的几轮中,代理商还检查学生评价轨迹,以了解预期行为在哪里出现,哪些弱点持续存在. 这些意见指导了它设计的技能以及它所应用的培训任务。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 2 , pilot rollouts test whether candidate skills elicit the intended behaviors without introducing new problems during task execution.
The agent uses the resulting trajectories to refine both the skill instructions and their scope of application, repeating trials as needed.

blocks.en:
The agent then scales promising interventions to batched rollouts and selects trajectories it judges valuable for training, considering both task outcomes and demonstrated behaviors.
The agent may also select unguided teacher trajectories that already exhibit useful behavioral patterns.
Feedback from generation and selection can prompt further revisions to skills or task coverage, followed by additional rollouts as needed.
The selected trajectories form the training set for the outer loop.

代理也可能选择已经表现出有用的行为模式的无导师轨迹.

blocks.en: 3.3 Outer Loop: Model Training and Feedback
blocks.zh: 3.3 外部循环:示范培训和反馈

blocks.en:
The outer loop evaluates the student trained on the demonstrations selected in each round.
In round r r , the inner loop produces a training set 𝒟 r \mathcal{D}_{r} .
SFT starts from the same initial student checkpoint θ 0 \theta_{0} in every round: θ r = SFT ⁡ ( θ 0 , 𝒟 r ) . \theta_{r}=\operatorname{SFT}(\theta_{0},\mathcal{D}_{r}). (2) The agent receives both scores and trajectories from evaluating θ r \theta_{r} without generated skills.
Scores summarize how well the student performs, while trajectories let the agent inspect how it handled individual tasks.
The agent can compare these observations with earlier skills, teacher rollouts, and training sets to decide whether to revise a skill, change its task coverage, or select different demonstrations in the next round. This experiment history carries forward, while each student is trained from θ 0 \theta_{0} .

blocks.en: 3.4 Infrastructure

blocks.en:
The infrastructure lets the AutoMaster agent test how a skill shapes teacher
behavior and examine whether the student exhibits that behavior after
fine-tuning (Figure 3 ).
From its Docker container, the agent uses the Model Context Protocol
(MCP) ( Anthropic, 2024 ) to access tasks and initial trajectories,
submit teacher rollout jobs, and launch SFT on selected demonstrations.
The rollout harness calls the teacher API,
while the evaluation harness queries the student model served by
SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . Both harnesses use a shared sandbox cluster
that runs task tools and verifiers in isolated Docker containers, allowing
multiple tasks to execute concurrently.

When an SFT job completes, the execution controller checks that the
checkpoint is available and automatically schedules evaluation. The training
and evaluation GPU clusters share a checkpoint store: SGLang workers load

avoiding an intermediate copy to the evaluation cluster. The controller also
records job and stage progress so that it can restart a failed inference
worker and resume evaluation without rerunning SFT.

blocks.en:
To understand how AutoMaster improves on Vanilla SFT,
we separately ablate skill guidance and data selection.
In w/o Skill Guidance , the LLM agent selects training
trajectories from unguided teacher rollouts.
In w/o Data Selection , the agent designs and refines
skills for a fixed, randomly sampled subset of training tasks,
without agent-directed trajectory selection.
Both variants retain autonomous experimentation with the same
teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe.

blocks.en:
Removing either component lowers mean performance in all six settings,
but their relative contributions vary
(Figure 4 ). On Terminal-Bench 2.1 with the

higher mean accuracy than selection from unguided rollouts

model size, the ordering reverses: selection from unguided rollouts
yields 45.77%, compared with 43.78% for guidance without selection.
One possible explanation is that the value of selection depends on
what the teacher already demonstrates: selection can favor trajectories
that exhibit useful behaviors, while guidance can elicit behaviors
that are rare in unguided rollouts.

blocks.en: 5.1 Behavioral Shaping Beyond Task Success
blocks.zh: 5.1 超越任务成功的行为

blocks.en:
Task success can conceal weaknesses in a teacher’s reasoning and actions.
To examine the behaviors targeted by Skill-FT, Figure 5 contrasts unguided and skill-guided teacher trajectories on the same tasks across three domains.
blocks.zh:
任务的成功可以掩盖教师的推理和行动上的弱点。
为了检查Skill-FT针对的行为,图5对比了三个领域相同任务的无导和技能导师轨迹.

blocks.en:
The first two cases illustrate behavioral differences that task outcomes alone cannot distinguish.
In Figure 5 (a), both executions satisfy the numerical error threshold, yet the unguided teacher claims fourth-order accuracy despite measured convergence of approximately second order.
The guided teacher uses independent numerical checks to revise and validate its method.
Similarly, both search executions in Figure 5 (b) reach the correct answer.
The unguided trajectory repeatedly pursues unverified award guesses before finding supporting records, while the guided trajectory uses retrieved episode–director records to identify and verify a candidate.
A filter based solely on successful completion would leave these behavioral differences unexamined.
blocks.zh:
前两个案例说明了单是任务结果无法区分的行为差异.
在图5(a)中,两处处决都符合数值误差阈值,而无指南的教师却声称第四顺序准确,尽管衡量了大约第二顺序的趋同程度。
指导教师使用独立的数字检查来修改和验证其方法。
同样,在图5(b)中,两次搜查处决都得出正确答案。
无导轨迹在寻找佐证记录之前反复进行未经核实的授标猜测,而有导轨迹则使用检索的插曲-导演记录来识别和验证候选人.
完全基于成功完成的过滤器将不检查这些行为差异。

blocks.en:
The third case highlights the importance of diagnosing verification failures.
Both executions initially construct a self-test with an input different from the specification while retaining the original expected order.
The unguided teacher reverses the global sorting rule to satisfy this mistaken expectation.
The guided teacher checks the input encoding, corrects the self-test, and preserves the specified rule, passing 38 of 38 tests compared with 32 of 38.
The useful behavior here is to establish what a failed check actually implies before changing the implementation.
blocks.zh:
第三个案例突出了诊断核查失败的重要性。
两次处决最初都是用不同于规格的输入来构建自我测试,同时保留原来的预期命令.
无导师逆转全球排序规则以满足这个错误的期望.
指导教师检查输入编码,校正自试,保留规定的规则,通过38个测试中的38个,而通过38个测试中的32个.
这里有用的行为是在改变执行之前确定一个失败的检查的实际含义.

blocks.en:
Across these cases, the guided trajectories illustrate changes in how
the teacher validates a numerical claim, redirects a search, or
diagnoses a failed check.
The first two cases show how skill guidance can address behavioral
weaknesses even when both executions succeed , while the third
illustrates an improvement in implementation correctness.
These differences highlight the value of examining demonstrated
behaviors alongside task outcomes to identify opportunities
for improvement.
AutoMaster identifies such opportunities through trajectory
analysis and designs skills to address them.
Together with the downstream results, these observations suggest
that Skill-FT can improve the training value of the demonstrations
produced by a fixed teacher.

blocks.en:
We investigate how to train the target model to better internalize
skill-guided behaviors.
Specifically, we examine whether the skill instructions used to guide
teacher rollouts should be retained during fine-tuning.
We compare Keep , which retains these instructions in the training
input, with Remove , which omits them.
Both conditions use the same trajectories and SFT recipe.
All models are evaluated without generated skills, following the official
evaluation protocols.

blocks.en:
Having examined how skill context affects learning from teacher
demonstrations, we next investigate how AutoMaster develops
the interventions used to generate and curate those demonstrations.
The agent draws on accumulated rollout and training feedback
to explore alternative behavioral hypotheses and intervention
strategies.

Figure 8 shows that continued

six benchmark–model settings.

on its predecessor.

three rounds before reaching 51.53% in the fourth.

The consistency of gains also differs across model sizes.
The 9B model exceeds Vanilla SFT in mean performance in every round across all three domains, whereas the 4B model does so throughout all five rounds only on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
The component ablations show a similar pattern: both variants exceed Vanilla SFT in all three domains for the 9B model, but only on BrowseComp for the 4B model (Section 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Skill-FT for shaping teacher behavior with natural-language skills and AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system that designs, executes, and refines these interventions.
Across three domains and two model sizes, AutoMaster achieves higher mean performance than Vanilla SFT.
The results and trajectory analyses suggest that a fixed model can become a more effective teacher through behavioral shaping, even on tasks it already solves.
Retaining skill instructions during SFT also yields higher mean performance than removing them, despite their absence at evaluation, suggesting that preserving skill context can support better behavioral internalization.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Skill-FT来塑造教师的自然语言技能行为,以及AutoMaster,这是一个自主的培训后系统,设计,执行和完善这些干预措施.
跨越三个域和两个模型大小,AutoMaster实现了比Vanilla SFT更高的平均性能.
结果和轨迹分析表明,一个固定模型可以通过行为塑造,甚至在它已经解决的任务上成为更有效的老师.
在SFT期间保留技能指令也产生比去除这些指令更高的平均性能,尽管这些指令在评价中缺席,这表明保存技能背景可以支持更好的行为内化.

blocks.en: Skill B.3 contract-checkpoint Instruction excerpts Keep a runnable public contract through construction Apply this when parsing, conversion, serialization, configuration, or stateful APIs compose several operations into a visible result. For a small independent function, use a direct input/output check; do not invent an architecture or a large test suite. [...] Diagnose and preserve the failing example Read the actual failing assertion and its input before changing code. Reduce that case and inspect the type and value at the first boundary that could explain the mismatch. Check whether the error belongs to parsing, conversion, state, or output only as the observations require. Fix the shared cause and rerun the original public assertion plus its contrasting case. If your expected value is wrong, establish why from the specification or a small independent calculation before changing it. blocks.en: Skill B.4 expression-grammar Complete instruction When implementing arithmetic with unary signs and powers, derive the grouping rules from the specification before changing parser calls. For conventional mathematical binding, recursive descent can use: sum     := product (("+" | "-") product)* product := prefix (("*" | "/" | "%") prefix)* prefix  := sign prefix | power power   := atom (power_operator prefix)? Here the power base excludes an ungrouped sign, but its right operand admits signs and further powers. In a Pratt or precedence-climbing parser, keep prefix parsing available at every operand entry; use infix binding thresholds for associativity. Adapt the existing parser, including only supported operators. For binary compatibility, preserve the reference’s grouping instead of imposing mathematical conventions. Check the actual evaluator with a signed base versus a grouped signed base, a signed expression in the right operand, and repeated powers. Derive expected values first; include a positive exponent formed with repeated signs when integer powers are required. Build-only repairs need no grammar change.
blocks.zh: 技能 B.4 表达式-语法 在用无记号和权力执行算术时,在改变剖析器调用之前,从规格中得出分组规则. 对于常规数学绑定,递归还原可以使用: sum:=产物(("+"QQ"-")产物) *产物:=前缀(("*"XQ"/"%")前缀) *前缀:=签前缀 QQ功率:=原子(动力-操作器前缀)? 在这里,权力基础排除了一个未组合的标志,但是它的正确操作承认了标志和进一步的权力. 在 Pratt 或优先级爬升解析器中,保留每个操作条目的前缀解析; 关联性使用内置绑定阈值 。 调整现有的解析器, 仅包括支持的运算符 。 对于二进制兼容性,保留参考的分组,而不是强加数学常规. 检查实际评价者,用一个签名的基数对一组签名的基数,用正确的操作来签名的表达式,以及重复的权力. 衍生预期值第一;包括当需要整数功率时,用重复的符号形成的正指数. 只有建筑修复不需要修改语法.
